title: Sources: Wix is expected to cut ~1,000 jobs in the coming months, or ~20% of its workforce, after weak Q1 earnings and a ~50% collapse of its stock in 2026 (Sophie Shulman/CTech)
commentary: Wix losing half its market cap in five months and now cutting a fifth of headcount is a clean case study in what happens when AI eats your core value proposition — website builders are exactly the commodity that agents commoditize first.
